messages:
natalie: Heads up: pen-test intake from partner scheduled for 2025-12-15. Need to confirm RBAC freeze window and evidence escrow owner.

ops: RBAC freeze - how long?

natalie: Freeze for one business day of the engagement window: 2025-12-15 00:00 -> 2025-12-15 23:59 UTC for IAM role edits on staging. Create exception process for emergency fixes.

kevin: Evidence escrow owner? ops or security?

natalie: Security should own the manifest & escrow, ops owns the presigned S3 path and role rotation.

engsec-bot: calendar invite created: "Partner Pen Test - Staging" 2025-12-15 09:00 UTC.

ops: I'll prepare exception runbook: `./request-rbac-exception --ticket 1234 --reason "hotfix" --ttl 1h --notify sec-oncall`.

kevin: We'll include `iam_policy_snapshots/` and `rbac_changes.log` in the artifact bag.

natalie: Also confirm we will not grant KMS decrypts. Provide signed attestations & sealed-blob fetch only.

ops: Affirmative.

kevin: I'll post sample manifest.csv and a tiny sample tar tomorrow.

natalie: Thanks, team. We'll run a 30-min checklist call day before. :calendar:
